limitations: Provider run/head binding was verified; archive-internal source revision was not independently established.
Known static-archive and Rust paths were not emitted by the selected-path collector. This does not establish absence at other paths.
The header inventory hashes symlink targets without resolving their contents.
17.65 GB denotes decompressed bytes read without inner extraction. Capacity for a future source+SDK+toolchain+link workload was not measured.
No visible retry errors were observed; zero internal action retries was not proved.
The observed clang 22.1.8 is not interchangeable with LLVM 19.1.7 discussed as a prior source reference.
ARM objdir payload was not acquired or inspected.

originalFailureComparison.intentBasis: Pinned daily/common workflow and schedule/job graph, not observed mozinfo from the original artifact.
